description: Published MIT / Hsu 2013 aggregate guide specificity score (crispr.mit.edu 'Guide score', CRISPOR calcMitGuideScore): 100/(100 + sum of per-hit scores) * 100, with per-hit scores from the Hsu model, or from the Tycko 2018 SaCas9 model for SaCas9 PAMs as the reference does. With include_alternative_pams=true the reference's alternative PAMs are scanned too and those hits are downweighted by 0.2, as annotateOfftargets does.

guide_sequence.description: Guide RNA sequence (length must match the system's guide length).

max_mismatches.description: Maximum allowed mismatches (range 0..5; default 4, the reference's default).

include_alternative_pams.description: Also scan the reference's alternative PAMs for this system (offtargetPams: NGG -> NAG, NGA; NNGRRT -> NNGRRN) and downweight NGG-guide alternative hits by 0.2, as CRISPOR's annotateOfftargets does. Default false = main PAM only. SpCas9 scans NAG and NGA (x0.2); SaCas9 scans NNGRRN (unweighted, as the reference).

min_alternative_pam_hit_score.description: With include_alternative_pams: minimum unweighted hit score (0..100) an alternative-PAM hit needs to count (reference ALTPAMMINSCORE / --minAltPamScore). Default 1.0, the reference's own default; 0 = no filtering.

on_target_start.description: Optional on-target interval start (0-based, inclusive; give both bounds or neither). Exact matches whose protospacer+PAM footprint lies inside [on_target_start, on_target_end) are skipped as the on-target (CRISPOR annotateOfftargets); other perfect matches are scored as off-targets. Omitted: every exact match is dropped.
